additional_info.subject: RE: ID0440087-DC/Si-D/AU- [MP / P6 170000724] Charger Issue CRM:02832000261
additional_info.body:
Hello Andrew,
Great, let me set up the meeting for you.
It does not appear to be related to the SIM card, we can see data for both OCPP and SCB.
We can see that the vehicle is going into charging phase and voltage is being applied.
Shortly after entering charging phase, we receive a EVSuspended message, indicating the vehicle has chosen to end the session.
It would also be beneficial to contact the Vehicle OEM, in case they are able to provide more information on this.
We require additional specific logs for analysis (Vehicle to charger specific) to understand more, this is with our global team for extraction.
Have there been any updates completed on the vehicle recently?
Has the charger been rebooted since this has started occurring?
Have both charging points been tested individually?
In terms of spare parts, do you currently have any of the following parts in your spare parts holding?
KF11, Part number: 8EM5903-0AA00-6AA3
KF12, Part number: 8EM5903-0AA00-5AA6
KF13, Part number: 8EM5903-0AA00-6AA1
Thanks for your time,
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd. Australia
Customer Services

additional_info.body:
Hi Andrew and Ferdinand,
I've had a look on our end regarding the remote stop. We had our system configured to stop charging a vehicle when it hits 99% SOC. That was primarily needed when we were trying to get the charger to work in sequential first-in, first-out mode.
Other than at that 99% point, it doesn't look like we have been sending remote stops.
I've turned this off in any case just to eliminate it as a possible cause.

Global General Manager - Customer Success

additional_info.body:
Hello Andrew,
Thanks for your time on the phone before.
As per our discussion, the charger logs are for internal diagnostics and we are unable to share them.
We have provided Custom denning with a quote last Friday (08/08) to review the charging sessions on the requested day and timeframe and provide a summary of each for their review.
Given that the Element 1 and Element 2 buses have been charging, we would expect that if the Element 1.5 was the same, it would charge as the other models.

Morning All,
@Andrew
,
Could you please clarify who specifically made the decision this morning that Custom Denning would be responsible for covering this work?

They have advised that, had the issues related to the Element 2’s, they would fully support the collaboration and repair process, this included obtaining the charge logs.
